easyPrerequisites: The card in your graveyard is Careful Study.
description:
Cast a copy of Careful Study by paying {U}.
Nantuko Shrine and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Nantuko Shrine trigger, creating at least one 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten, blinking Spellbook Seeker // Careful Study, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding one mana.
Resolve the Careful Study copy, drawing two cards and discarding two cards.
Repeat.
